title: The Oath of Highmoor Again
author: Edmund Winterbourne
blurb: Elodie Nakamura, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
